column1: # Hand-curated concept metadata overrides, by Concepticon gloss.
# freq: frequency class 1 (most frequent) .. 5 (rare). Defaults: Swadesh 3,
# stab: lexical stability 1 (very stable: pronouns, low numerals) .. 5
#       (often replaced). Default 3. Informed by Pagel et al. 2007 and
# taboo: 1 if the concept attracts euphemistic replacement.
# The rest of the Swadesh-207 list. stab 2: on the Leipzig-Jakarta list
# (Tadmor 2009, the 100 meanings most resistant to borrowing and
# replacement); 3: the rest of Swadesh-100; 4: Swadesh-200 items that real
# lists show replaced often (dimensions, secondary colours, weather and
# manner verbs, spouses). freq follows everyday corpus frequency.
# Kin terms and body words among the grammaticalization sources.
